description: Resource attributes for tenant_setting resources. Populated by tenant settings resource descriptors and typed settings document descriptors.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant identifier. Used by islamuevent_tenant_admin derived role.

isLockedByInstance.description: Whether this setting is locked by an instance admin. Used in policy condition to prevent tenant admin updates.

settingKey.description: Registered tenant setting key. Storage administration sends the bounded key 'storage' for HAL affordance checks.

documentKey.description: Optional typed settings document key. tenant.branding is authorized before handler-level field lock validation.
